Goal
* Consider replacing the existing list of scoring combinations with a table like the one below (including the backticks) to improve readability. Please retain the existing clarification about straights.

```
Combination       Definition           Points  Example
---------------------------------------------------------
Pair              Only one value         1     4 5 6 7 5
                    appears exactly
                    twice
Two pairs         Two distinct values    3     5 6 6 10 5
                    appear exactly
                    twice each
Three of a kind   One value appears      3     7 8 7 7 4
                    exactly three
                    times
Full house        Three of a kind        8     4 9 4 4 9
                    plus a pair

Four of a kind    One value appears      6     6 3 6 6 6
                    exactly four
                    times
Five of a kind    One value appears     10     8 8 8 8 8
                    exactly five
                    times
Straight          7 appears in a         8     7 10 8 6 9
  containing a 7    straight

Straight          7 does not appear     12     3 5 2 6 4
  without a 7       in a straight
```

* For clarification, please replace "A full house scores" with "A smaller combination formed by a subset of the five numbers does not count. For example, a full house scores".

* Consider explicitly stating that straights cannot wrap around (for example, 10 11 12 2 3 is not a straight).

Input
* Please format "5 lines" in <<bold>>.

Cases
* For the first 8 pairs of cases (which serve to introduce one combination at a time):

  • The order of the case pairs differs from the order of the combinations in the statement. Consider reordering either.

  • Each test always contains exactly one occurrence of the featured combination, whereas each validator always contains exactly two. Please revise the cases to introduce more variety: e.g. a validator containing only one occurrence, or a case containing more than two occurrences.

* "No combination" (validator) expects an output of 1, so the case is inconsistent with the scenario intended to cover. Please revise the case.

Thanks.
Thanks for the detailed review! I think I addressed all points.

Thank you for the update! Below are my comments on the revised version.

Goal
* Please remove the sentence "Four consecutive numbers plus one other number is not a straight." Singling out four consecutive numbers seems arbitrary, and "one other number" is imprecise, as the additional number could actually complete a sequence of five consecutive numbers with the original four.

The first sentence already clearly defines a straight as five consecutive numbers, so the second sentence is largely redundant and could be removed.

* Please add "for example," before "10 11 12 2 3".

Cases
* Full house (validator): Please revise the case to include 3 instances of a full house.

* Straight without 7 (test): Please revise the case to include 3 instances of a straight without 7.

Thanks again.
Done. Thanks for the quick reply!
Looks good to me. Thank you too!
